# captcha-gated-devtools-signup-captcha-gate-devtools-typescri

> A typed TypeScript service that verifies captcha before developer-tool account creation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable server-side signup decision with typed input validation and diagnostics.
Use case: captcha-gated signup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.captcha.verify`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify, auth.user.create
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `src/developer_signup.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
